Correlation + BH FDR filter (the package default)

Source: R/filtering.R
correlation_filtering.Rd

Keeps groups with correlation >= cor_thresh and fdr <= fdr_thresh. Groups with NA correlation are dropped. Conforms to filter-contract.

Usage

correlation_filtering(cor_thresh = 0.3, fdr_thresh = 0.01)

Arguments

cor_thresh

Minimum Pearson correlation to keep.

fdr_thresh

Maximum BH-adjusted FDR to keep.

Value

A filter closure — see filter-contract.

Details

The factory defaults (0.3, 0.01) differ from the defaults the process_*() functions build when filter_fn = NULL (0.1, 0.1).

See also

apex_correlation_filtering(), correlation_statistics()
